question: Do the two publicly dated white-coloured sister systems reproduce the frozen Azami present-day direction higher surface shortwave radiation -> lower visible corolla Lab chroma?

input_cohort.provenance: Derived without environmental outcome selection from the successful PR149 public-image measurement run 33463726473; raw images are not redistributed.

environment_source.source_contract: current CHELSA v2.1 climatology, exactly matching the Azami process-environment source registry

primary_estimand.grain: dated sister system, taxon-median present state
primary_estimand.environment_difference: median_RSDS_white_taxon - median_RSDS_coloured_taxon using all 14 balanced coordinates per taxon
primary_estimand.phenotype_difference: median_chroma_white_taxon - median_chroma_coloured_taxon using only colour_status=usable observations
primary_estimand.reason: Matches the among-taxon grain of the frozen Azami colour-RSDS candidate and avoids treating public within-taxon photographs as macroevolutionary replicates.

secondary_estimands: 0.05-degree taxon-by-cell median sensitivity before sister-system contrast, to reduce repeated-locality leverage
within-taxon demeaned chroma~RSDS slope pooled across all four taxa with predictor permutation restricted within taxon
within-taxon demeaned slope separately inside each sister system
bootstrap intervals for taxon-median RSDS and chroma differences
multiplicity: No environment-variable screen: RSDS and chroma are the single frozen predictor-endpoint pair. Secondary slopes and cell aggregation are diagnostics, not additional discovery tests.
claim_boundary: This tests present-state spatial concordance with Azami, not the historical environmental cause of colour transition.
Current RSDS is a correlated observational gradient and does not isolate direct solar selection.
Taxon RSDS contrasts can also reflect geography, elevation, ancestry and other correlated environmental differences.
Public observations can cluster spatially; the 0.05-degree cell sensitivity is required before interpreting locality-robust direction.
Two sister systems do not establish a general macroevolutionary law, convergence, selection or adaptation.
Do not treat CHELSA current surface RSDS as a historical surface-radiation reconstruction.
